text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Misato is telling {0}
about the children she's taking care of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサトは自分が世話をしている子どもたちのことを
{0}に話していた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That one over there's quite the handful.
He gets jealous if he sees me patting any of the other children.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子は本当に甘えん坊さんでね、
私が他の子を撫でたりすると
やきもちをやいちゃったりするのよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I let the others rest their heads on my lap quite often,
and he always looks like he wants to try it as well.
Except he runs away whenever I beckon him over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
膝枕している子なんかを見ると
羨ましそうに見てくるんだけど、
おいで～
って言うと恥ずかしがって逃げちゃうのよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
There's all sorts of children here,
but I treat them all like my very own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
色んな子がいるけど、
みーんな自分の子みたいで可愛いわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪Would you like to use my lap as a pillow, too?
It comes highly recommended by the children.
Come on. No need to be shy. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ♪　
よかったらあなたも膝枕してみる？
私の膝枕、
子どもたちに大人気なのよ～。
ほーら、
おいで～♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my.
You seem to be awfully shiny, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら？　
なにかしら～
{0}君、凄く光ってるわよ～

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh! Waaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわーん、
うわーん！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. That looked painful.
Don't worry, though. I'll make it all better.
Pain, pain, go away! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
転んじゃったのね～。
大丈夫よ～
先生がおまじないかけてあげる。
痛いの痛いの、
飛んでけー♪

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
*sniff* *hic*
Hehe... Ehehe. ♪
Thanks, Miss Misato!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐすっ……
ひっく……
へへ、
えへへ♪
美里先生ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, my little friend.
You wiped your own tears away.
That's incredibly brave of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
よしよし。
泣き止めたわね～、
さすが男の子。
かっこいいな～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't {0}.
Hello there. On one of your patented walks, perhaps?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら？　{0}君じゃない。
こんにちは。
お散歩かな？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Miss Misato! Lemme lay on your lap!
text_block_list.orig_text: 先生膝枕してー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Yes, yes. You sure love to be spoiled, don't you?
Hehe. Sorry. It's playtime for the children right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらあら、
はいはい。
やっぱり甘えん坊さんね～
ふふ、
ちょうど子どもたちと公園で遊ぶ時間なのよ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
How about you join us?
I'm sure the children will love it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よければ{0}君もどうかしら？
一緒に遊んでくれたら子どもたちも喜ぶわー

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey! Are you here for some lap action, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なになにー！　
お兄ちゃんも美里先生に膝枕してもらいに来たのー？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No one gives better lap pillows than her!
It's like... you get all these fluffy, warm feelings!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
先生の膝枕気持ちいいんだよー！
なんかねー、
ふわふわぽかぽかーってするの！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Hearing that puts a smile on my face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
そう言ってもらえると嬉しいわ～

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I knew it! She gives the best lap pillows!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりー！　
先生の膝枕ちょー気持ちいいよねー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Someone else is looking to be spoiled, I see. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
甘えん坊さんがもう一人♪

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
You can go first, then!
I've gotten to do it loads already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあお兄ちゃんが先でいいよー！
ぼくいつもやってもらってるから！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Well, well.
Aren't you kind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
優しいのね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Now then, {0}.
Welcome to Miss Misato's lap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ♪　
それじゃあ{0}君、
先生のお膝にどうぞ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
How is it?
All the children love it.
choice_data_list: Humanity lacks the vocabulary to describe this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうかしら～
園児のみんなには好評なんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! ♪
Looking for some extra attention, are we?
Just call me \"Mama,\" then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら♪　{0}君ったら♪
甘えん坊さんね。
よーしよし、
ママですよ～

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Wow! You two are all lovey-dovey!
text_block_list.orig_text: 先生とお兄ちゃんラブラブだー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Who's been a bad influence on you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらこの子ったら、
どこで覚えたのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: My mom and dad! They're always super lovey-dovey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくのパパとママがね、
いつもラブラブなの！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well then. That's good to hear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
パパとママは仲良しなのね～

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Mom and dad always kiss and stuff, though.
How about you two? You should smooch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
先生とお兄ちゃんはちゅーしないのー？
パパとママはいつもしてるよー？　
むちゅーって！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Whatever shall we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらあら、
どうしましょうかね～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And there we have it. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Think of what you just saw as something of a dream.
Chances are you'll forget about it as soon as you wake up,
so no need to brood over it that much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが今、見てたのは夢みたいなものよ。
目覚めたらほとんど忘れちゃうと思うし、
今はあんまり気にしなくてもいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Talk about getting spoiled, though.
Don't you think you're a bit too old for that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしてもあんたあんなに甘えて……
いい年して恥ずかしくないの？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Sent shivers right down my spine, if I'm being honest.
Moreso since you seemed into it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てるこっちからしたらゾッとしたわよ。
あんたはノリのつもりかもしれないけど。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
If anything, though, it's just proof that
Misato more than lives up to her \"saint\" moniker.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあそれすら嫌な顔せず包み込むミサトさんって、
やっぱり聖母って感じよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't mind having a teacher like that to take care of me, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしもあんな先生にお世話してもらいたいわ～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Oops. Let's stop this conversation right here.
As for you, don't let people spoil you too much, okay? Bye-bye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと話しすぎてもあれだし、
今回はこのへんにしとくわ。
甘えすぎもほどほどにするのよ？　
じゃあねー

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh?
Oh my. Looks like we both fell asleep together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
あら？
あらあら、
気付かず二人でお昼寝しちゃってたみたいね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I seem to remember dreaming about giving you a lap pillow, too.
Did we talk about something similar before falling asleep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
寝ちゃう前にお話しをしたからかしら……
夢の中で{0}君を膝枕してた気がするわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
You had the same dream?
Oh my! That's quite the coincidence!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら！　
もしかしてあなたも同じ夢を見てたの？　
不思議ね～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪
How about we turn that dream into reality?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ♪
……膝枕、
しましょうか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'm more than fine with it.
Let yourself get spoiled now and then. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのよ～
たくさん甘えてくれて♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Just call me \"Mama.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぉら、
ママですよ～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Though elated over his current predicament, 
{0} found himself a little bit embarrassed as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
膝枕は嬉しい反面、
少し恥ずかしい{0}だった。
